lines.text: In this lesson, you will learn to make apps robust: re-ask until input is valid, handle every menu choice, and organise features into procedures.
Keep asking until the input makes sense: repeat until the answer is in range.
The program never continues with bad data.
A menu asks the user to choose 1, 2 or 3.
An if-else chain handles each choice — and the final else catches anything else.
Put each menu option in its own My Block.
The menu just calls the right one.
Easy to read, easy to extend.
Test empty answers, words instead of numbers, negative numbers and huge numbers.
A robust app handles them politely.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now build along, then try the challenges. You’ve got this!
